name: Necromancer Crypt Keeper makes Crypt Swarm bounce to 2 more enemies (#791)
contract: Crypt Keeper 560596 is an Animation talent (CharacterAdvancement 7112, ClassType 25 = class 23, Tab 61, TalentEssenceCost 1, choice group with Unrelenting 704718) whose description reads 'Your Crypt Swarm now bounces to 2 additional nearby enemies, at ${-($800343f1-1)*100}% reduced value per enemy struck.' Effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) MiscValue 17 (SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS), BasePoints 1 + DieSides 1 = 2, EffectSpellClassMask (0, 0, 0x200) in SpellFamilyName 29; effect 1 (SPELLMOD_DAMAGE) has amount 0. The only 0x200 holder is Crypt Swarm's damage 800343 (family flags 0, 0, 0x200; TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ENEMY, EffectChainTarget 1, EffectDamageMultiplier 0.7, DmgClass magic), which the channel 500965 triggers every EffectAmplitude through SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL_WITH_VALUE, cast by the Necromancer because 800343 needs an explicit unit target. Spell::SelectImplicitChainTargets adds the caster's SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS to EffectChainTarget, so each tick strikes 1 enemy without the talent and 3 with it, chaining to the nearest enemy within 10 yd; the 0.7 per-jump multiplier ($800343f1 = 0.7, i.e. 30% less) is native DBC data and is not measured here because critical strikes make single hits nondeterministic. Three golems stand 3 yd apart in a line: before the talent only the channel target takes Crypt Swarm damage, after it all three do.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Channel Crypt Swarm without the talent
SETUP: Crypt Swarm damages its target
CONTROL: the second golem is not struck without the talent
CONTROL: the third golem is not struck without the talent
Channel Crypt Swarm with the talent
The channel target is still struck
DISCRIMINATING: Crypt Swarm bounces to the second golem
Crypt Swarm bounces on to the third golem
